# TravelPulse

> TravelPulse is a global travel dashboard for discovering tourist destinations
> on an interactive 3D globe and booking travel routes across Tamil Nadu, India.

## About

TravelPulse lets travelers explore the world's most breathtaking landscapes and
cultural wonders through an interactive 3D globe, a searchable destination
catalog with category and country filters, and a booking system for travel
routes (bus, train, ferry) across Tamil Nadu. Accounts let users create, confirm,
and manage their bookings.

## Main pages

- Home (interactive globe + search): https://luminous-swan-08e721.netlify.app/index.html
- Browse Destinations (filterable catalog): https://luminous-swan-08e721.netlify.app/pages/destinations.html
- My Bookings (requires login): https://luminous-swan-08e721.netlify.app/pages/bookings.html
- Login / Register: https://luminous-swan-08e721.netlify.app/pages/login.html

## Tech

- Frontend: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with globe.gl for the 3D globe
- Backend: Flask + SQLAlchemy REST API (see backend/ folder)
